information:
**Important Reminders for Participants**

Please ensure you arrive at the venue at least 15 minutes prior to your event start time to guarantee your participation. Late arrivals will not be permitted.

If you are participating in a WCA competition for the first time or are unfamiliar with the competition rules, we highly recommend attending the tutorial session. This session will provide you with essential information and guidance.

For first-time WCA competitors, kindly remember to bring your ID card along. This will help facilitate the registration process and ensure a smooth experience.

Thank you for your cooperation, and we wish you a fantastic competition!

Team mcubes!
